data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'basileus' meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. In Christianity, the term 'reign' is used to describe the eternal kingdom of God. in_hebrew.name: רֶאִיגן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רֶאִיגן מקורו במילה העברית 'מלכות' או 'שלטון', המתאר את כוחו וסמכותו של מלך או שליט. במשמעות רוחנית, השם מייצג את המלכות האלוהית ואת השלטון האלוהי על העולם. השם רֶאִיגן משמש כהזמנה להאמין באלוהים כמלך העולם וכשולט על כל דבר.

in_greek.name: Ρέιγκν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ρέιγκν προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'βασιλεία' που σημαίνει 'κυριαρχία' ή 'εξουσία'. Στην πνευματική του σημασία, το όνομα Ρέιγκν αντιπροσωπεύει τη βασιλεία του Θεού και την κυριαρχία Του στον κόσμο. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμεύει ως πρόσκληση να πιστέψουμε στον Θεό ως τον βασιλιά του κόσμου και ως τον κυβερνήτη όλων των πραγμάτων.

in_latin.name: Regnum
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Regnum derives from the Latin word 'regnum', meaning 'kingdom', 'reign', or 'sovereignty'. In a spiritual context, Regnum signifies the kingdom of God and His sovereignty over the world. This name serves as an invitation to believe in God as the King of the world and as the ruler of all things.

in_english.name: Reign
in_english.meaning: To rule or govern as a king
in_english.long_meaning: The name Reign originates from the Latin 'regnum', meaning 'kingdom' or 'reign'. It symbolizes the power and authority of a king or ruler. In a Christian context, Reign represents the kingdom of God and His sovereignty over the world. The name Reign conveys a sense of leadership, power, and spiritual strength. It is often associated with the qualities of a Christian leader or a servant of God.

data.cultural_impact: The concept of 'reign' is deeply ingrained in Christian theology, symbolizing God's sovereignty and power over the world. it is also associated with the idea of a clear and absolute rule, evoking images of strong and just kings in biblical stories. This term has influenced various Christian art, literature, and hymns, reflecting the belief in the ultimate victory of God's rule over all things.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the idea of a divine 'reign' represents the eternal kingdom of God, a place where love, peace, and justice rule above all. It reminds us of the reality of God's Kingdom, reminding us to live our lives in accordance with His will. The concept of 'reign' also reflects the belief in the ultimate triumph of good over evil, and the hope that one day, all things will be under God's loving and just rule, ultimately bringing rest, peace, and fulfillment to all creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A Christian name "Reign" symbolizes divine rule and sovereignty in one's life. It is a reminder to seek God's will and reign in His love, trusting in His kingdom's enduring power.
